pages.title: Ship & Fish
pages.creator: KDS Group
pages.description: Ship Fish challenges you to keep a ship alive while fish attack from different directions. Move away from the approaching threats and look for a clear route through them. Your score grows with the time you manage to survive.

pages.title: Rainbow Friends. Survival
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Rainbow Friends Survival sends you through five days and nights of dangerous tasks. Explore the setting, interact with objects and complete the missions while monsters search for you. Keep an escape route in mind when a creature moves into the area.

pages.title: Safe Merge
pages.creator: LHZ
pages.description: Safe Merge asks you to combine safes with the same design to unlock stronger versions. Select safes for the available earning slots and use the income to continue merging. Prestige increases the money generated each cycle as you work toward the remaining designs.

pages.title: Super Tank Wrestle
pages.creator: Raccoon
pages.description: Super Tank Wrestle puts you in control of a tank across different combat maps. Move into a useful position and fire at the opposing machines. Try the available tank choices while working out how to survive each battlefield.

pages.title: Noob: parkour tricks
pages.creator: Stickman vs Monster School Team
pages.description: Noob Parkour Tricks takes a blocky character through obstacle courses toward a portal. Jump over gaps, avoid holes and collect diamonds along the way. Judge each landing so you can continue across the platforms to the exit.

pages.title: Princess Rescue: Save Girl
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Princess Rescue Save Girl uses colored ammunition and advancing dragons in a rescue puzzle. Select and dispatch the available ammo boxes to bring the weapons into action. Plan their order around the dragon's colors while protecting the princess from its advance.

pages.title: Monster Escape
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Monster Escape asks you to turn an entire level to guide a green monster. Use gravity to reach the key and then the exit, watching how each rotation changes the route. Keep the character away from spikes and falling crates.

pages.title: Word Art – Color Book Puzzle
pages.creator: Gameyogi
pages.description: Word Art Color Book brings color into a scene through words rather than ordinary painting tools. Drag each word to the place where it belongs and reveal the corresponding artwork. Match the labels with the picture to complete the scene.

pages.title: Cozy Garden Idle
pages.creator: Mad Pixel Games LTD
pages.description: Cozy Garden Idle lets you reveal and nurture plants as a garden develops. Pick the available growth, gather the game's oxygen resource and use it to expand. Keep returning to the plants as you open more of the garden.

pages.title: GT Championship Arcade
pages.creator: Breymantech
pages.description: GT Championship Arcade puts GT cars on neon racing circuits. Steer through the course and compete with rival drivers for position. Adjust your approach to each bend while trying to carry enough speed toward the next section.

pages.title: Get a cool gun!
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Get Cool Gun is a weapon-building runner about combining gun parts into an improved setup. Collect and upgrade modules while advancing along the route. Use the resulting weapon to shoot obstacles and enemies that stand in the way.

pages.title: Valley of Wolves Ambush
pages.creator: Merlot Games
pages.description: Valley Wolves Ambush gives you a fort to defend against repeated enemy attacks. Stay inside its area and stop the waves before the fort or your character is lost. Spend combat earnings on weapons to prepare for the next assault.

pages.title: IDLE Archeology
pages.creator: AA2G1
pages.description: Idle Archeology turns excavations into a dinosaur museum project. Hire workers, dig through the site and use dynamite to help uncover bones. Assemble the discoveries into skeletons and develop the museum as more remains become available.

pages.title: Xmas Mahjong Trio Solitaire
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Xmas Mahjong Trio asks you to gather identical seasonal tiles into sets of three. Selected tiles wait in a stack that can hold only nine pieces. Plan matches before choosing another tile so the temporary space does not overflow.

pages.title: Delete Puzzle Parts
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Delete Puzzle Parts presents scenes with a detail that needs to be erased. Study the picture and rub away the relevant section to reveal the solution. Look for what the scene is hiding before removing more of the drawing.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Candy 3
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Bubble Shooter Candy 3 lets you fire candy into a matching arrangement. Join at least three of the same kind to clear them and charge the universal candy. Swap to the next shot when its color offers a better placement.

pages.title: Merge Master Army Clash
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Merge Master Army Clash sends you down a route where you can recruit and combine soldiers. Avoid barriers while building a stronger force for the battle at the end. Choose a path that leaves the army ready for its opponents.

pages.title: Noob trolls Pro
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Noob Trolls Pro sends Noob sneaking into Pro's house to set up pranks. Find usable items, prepare the mischief and leave before being spotted. Work through larger houses with tricks involving objects such as TNT and zombies.

pages.title: Backrooms Escape 1
pages.creator: NISHAD_Games
pages.description: Backrooms Escape 1 puts you inside a maze of yellow rooms with tasks to complete. Explore the passages, examine useful objects and search for a way out. Remember the turns you have already taken while looking for the next objective.

pages.title: Icy Dress Up
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description: Icy Dress Up lets you create looks for two princess sisters. Choose their hairstyles, apply makeup and browse clothing for each character. Coordinate the available pieces to give both sisters outfits suited to their icy setting.

pages.title: Fabby Golf!
pages.creator: Seryas Games
pages.description: Fabby Golf asks you to send a ball into the hole with a carefully judged shot. Drag to aim and set the power, then release to take the stroke. Use the result to adjust your approach to the next attempt.

pages.title: Paper Us Online
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Paper US Online makes you the attacker in a timed stealth challenge. Approach characters from behind and eliminate them before the clock runs out. Keep moving through the setting while looking for an opening behind the remaining targets.

pages.title: Alpha Guns
pages.creator: Ramblo Digital Media
pages.description: Alpha Guns is a side-scrolling action game with armed enemies and boss encounters. Run, jump and shoot through the stages while collecting stronger weapons and upgrades. Watch the platforms and enemy attacks as you push farther into the level.

pages.title: Hamster Maze Online
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Hamster Maze follows a hamster through obstacle-filled paths toward food. Guide the animal around the barriers and look for a route through each maze. Collect the available rewards and unlock new appearances as you progress.

pages.title: Coffee Puzzle
pages.creator: OneTwoPlay IT
pages.description: Coffee Puzzle mixes food matching with a delivery problem. Make groups of three to clear the pieces blocking a cup's route to the customer. Consider where the coffee needs to travel before choosing which match to make.

pages.title: Tactical Knight
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Tactical Knight asks you to defeat enemies in an order the knight can survive. Read their star-based strength and collect swords to improve your position. Plan the route carefully so the fight does not send the knight into the sea.

pages.title: Modern Lolita Girly Fashion
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Modern Lolita Girly Fashion gives Mia, Emma and Clara new wardrobes to explore. Choose outfits inspired by modern Lolita fashion and coordinate the available accessories. Create a separate look for each character using the clothing options on display.

pages.title: Shot
pages.creator: kidsgamesplay
pages.description: Shot is a timing challenge built around a rotating arrow and a small circular target. Fire when the arrow points along the right line, then adapt when the next target changes position. Three missed shots bring the attempt to an end.

pages.title: Dot Tap
pages.creator: kidsgamesplay
pages.description: Dot Tap asks you to time a moving blue ball so it meets a purple target. Tap at the moment their positions line up to complete the hit. Reassess the timing when the target shifts to another location.

pages.title: Unblock Parking Puzzle
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Unblock Parking Puzzle turns a congested parking area into a logic challenge. Work out which vehicles can leave and release them in an order that clears the traffic. Consider the blocked routes before sending the next car forward.

pages.title: Lovely Couples Memory
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Lovely Couples Memory hides matching pictures of couples across a card board. Reveal two cards at a time and remember where each image appears. Find all the pairs to finish the arrangement with fewer unnecessary turns.

pages.title: Madman Runner
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Madman Runner sends a runner along a road filled with cars, tires and bombs. Jump past danger while collecting coins and food on the route. Keep watching the next obstacle so a reward does not draw you into a collision.

pages.title: Bullet Shooter
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Bullet Shooter lets you control a bullet after it has been fired. Swipe to steer its path toward the red targets and around the objects in the way. Adjust the turn early enough to bring the projectile onto its next target.

pages.title: Cooking Korean Lesson
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Cooking Korean Lesson introduces kitchen activities based on kimchi and bibimbap. Prepare the ingredients, use the available cooking tools and follow the steps for each dish. Work through the side preparations as you put the meal together.

pages.title: Dream Pet Link
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Dream Pet Link is a timed puzzle about connecting identical animal tiles. Find a matching pair with an available linking route and remove it from the board. Clear the nine levels by opening paths to the tiles that remain.

pages.title: Counter Terrorist Shooting Strike
pages.creator: gameworld
pages.description: Counter Terrorist Shooting Strike puts you in a team-based first-person firefight. Move through the combat area, aim with the mouse and shoot at opposing fighters. Keep track of nearby threats while helping your side gain the advantage.

pages.title: Infinity Run
pages.creator: Fat Boy Studio
pages.description: Infinity Run sends a ball down a sloping route with shaped obstacles ahead. Move left or right to line up with an opening that matches the ball's shape. Keep checking the next barrier before committing to a lane.

pages.title: Island Survival 3D
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Island Survival 3D is a ball-control obstacle course with stages to complete. Roll through the route using the movement keys, keeping the ball away from hazards and dangerous edges. Later levels add jumping to the movements needed to reach the finish.

pages.title: Finding Zombies
pages.creator: Arcade Lemon
pages.description: Finding Zombies is an action game about striking approaching zombies. React to threats coming from the left and right and stop them before they reach the character. Keep switching attention between both sides as more enemies arrive.

pages.title: Car Physics BTR 80
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Car Physics BTR 80 gives you an eight-wheeled vehicle for rough uphill routes. Drive over obstacles, gather coins and keep the machine balanced as it climbs. Use nitro when helpful while working toward a quick finish.

pages.title: Transport Jigsaw Deluxe
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Transport Jigsaw Deluxe offers transport pictures with classic and wavy-piece puzzle modes. Choose a format and reconnect the scattered parts of the selected scene. Follow the vehicle details and surrounding colors to find where each piece belongs.

pages.title: A Penguin Love
pages.creator: Tori Games
pages.description: A Penguin Love follows a penguin searching for his children and trying to reunite with his wife. Jump through stages across four worlds while collecting coins and stars. Time the jumps around the obstacles that separate the family.

pages.title: Selling Trucks Match 3
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Selling Trucks Match 3 fills its board with matching puzzle pieces to line up. Make groups of three or more to increase the score and keep the left-side meter from falling too far. Look for the next combination as the board changes.

pages.title: Hard Flap
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Hard Flap challenges you to guide a bouncing ball past moving obstacles. Jump at the right time to avoid contact, keeping in mind that only six consecutive jumps are available. Watch the different obstacle speeds before deciding when to rise.

pages.title: Adjust in the wall
pages.creator: GameOnHai
pages.description: Adjust in the Wall asks you to reposition a loose block before the approaching wall reaches it. Move left or right to find the single shape that fits the opening. Make the adjustment in time to pass through without a collision.

pages.title: Running Dragon
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Running Dragon sends a dragon fleeing from a pursuing fireball. Collect coins and diamonds to increase your speed while avoiding saws that slow the escape. Keep choosing a clear route so the fire does not close the gap.

pages.title: Barber Cut
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Barber Cut turns hair trimming into a swipe-controlled activity. Move the cutting tool through the hair and work through the different styles presented by the game. Judge the remaining areas before making another cut.

pages.title: Memory Icon
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Memory Icon asks you to uncover pairs of matching pictures. Turn over the icons, remember their locations and select the identical partner to earn points. Use each reveal to reduce the searching needed on later turns.

pages.title: Soccer Challenge
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Soccer Challenge turns passing into a football puzzle. Send the ball between yellow teammates while keeping red opponents out of the passing line. Reach the goal with as few passes as possible to improve the score across the levels.

pages.title: Cartoon Ship Puzzle
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Cartoon Ship Puzzle offers illustrated ships to rebuild as jigsaws. Select a picture and connect the scattered pieces using the boat's shapes and colors. There is no time limit, so you can work through the image at your own pace.

pages.title: Fruit Knife Hit
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Fruit Knife Hit is a target challenge about throwing knives at fruit. Click to launch a knife and judge the moment that gives it a clear path. Watch the target's position before making the next throw.

pages.title: Go Chicken Go
pages.creator: RavalMatic
pages.description: Go Chicken Go follows escaped chickens facing a busy highway on their way to freedom. Move with the direction keys and jump when needed to cross the road. Watch approaching traffic before taking another step into its path.

pages.title: Curly Haired Jigsaw
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Curly Haired Jigsaw gives you twelve pictures to assemble at three difficulty levels. Choose 25, 49 or 100 pieces and reconnect the selected image. Use the hair, faces and background details to guide each placement.

pages.title: Skydiving Iron
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Skydiving Iron puts you in control of an armored flying character dodging enemy missiles. Move away from incoming attacks while collecting points for equipment improvements. Keep scanning the flight area so another missile does not catch you during the escape.

pages.title: Pong
pages.creator: Nela´s games
pages.description: Pong brings the classic racket-and-ball contest to the screen. Move your racket to return the ball and keep the opponent from scoring. Watch the ball's angle after each rebound and reposition for the next return.

pages.title: Smart EQ Forfour Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Smart EQ Forfour Puzzle offers six car pictures as jigsaws. Choose a 16-, 36-, 64- or 100-piece version, then rebuild the vehicle and its surroundings. Increase the piece count when you want a more demanding puzzle.

pages.title: Steam Trucker2
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Steam Trucker 2 asks you to deliver cargo over an uneven route. Use the arrow keys to control the truck and adjust your speed around bumps. Reach the delivery point while protecting the shipment from damage along the way.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Playdate
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Baby Hazel Playdate follows Hazel visiting Jake while their mothers catch up. Help attend to the children's needs as they take part in indoor and outdoor activities. Interact with the characters and objects to keep the playdate moving.

pages.title: The House Of Evil Granny
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: The House of Evil Granny traps you inside a house with a hostile resident. Explore for the battery, key and tools needed to open the front door while avoiding Granny's pursuit. Use hiding and movement carefully as you work through the locks.

pages.title: Real Bottle Shooter Game
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Real Bottle Shooter Game challenges you to break bottles with aimed shots. Select a target, line up the weapon and fire to shatter it. Work through the available environments while trying to make each shot count.

pages.title: Amazing Princess Coloring Book
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Amazing Princess Coloring Book gives you princess drawings to color in your own style. Select a character and use the movable palette on the right to choose colors. Follow a familiar look or experiment with a new combination for the picture.

pages.title: Sliding Santa
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Sliding Santa sends Santa down slippery, zigzagging snowy lanes to gather Christmas gifts. Time the changes of direction to keep following the path through the forest. Unlock other characters, some of which bring a different setting to the ride.

pages.title: Safari Chef
pages.creator: Minijuegos.com
pages.description: Safari Chef is a physics puzzle about getting food to animals. Draw shapes that guide the prepared food toward the right recipient, accounting for each animal's needs. Work through the chef's travels with a new delivery problem at each stop.

pages.title: Moto MX
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Moto MX challenges you to score points on a motorbike without falling. Tap or click to jump and perform backflips, then judge the landing before attempting another stunt. Keep the bike under control to continue building the run.

pages.title: Fat Soccer
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Fat Soccer combines football with special attacks that can disrupt an opponent. Move into scoring positions while making use of the fighter-like abilities available to your player. Watch for an opening after an attack to send the ball toward goal.

pages.title: Supermarket Mania
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Supermarket Mania lets you explore a virtual grocery-shopping trip. Work through activities involving the supermarket and the items on offer. Follow the game's prompts as you take part in the shopping experience.

pages.title: Agent Curiosa Rogue Robots
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Agent Curiosa Rogue Robots follows a young hacker fighting machines with a homemade electric zapper. Clear robot-filled stages, confront larger drones in boss encounters and collect helpful items. Bonuses such as invisibility or extra lives can help you continue the mission.

pages.title: Pipe Mania
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: Pipe Mania asks you to connect a water route from the starting pipe to the target. Arrange the pieces so the flow reaches its destination without a leak. Complete the current layout to unlock the next piping challenge.

pages.title: Master Chess Multiplayer
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Master Chess Multiplayer lets you play chess against the computer or online opponents. Select a piece and its destination to make a legal move, balancing attacks with protection of your king. Build a position that forces checkmate to win the match.

pages.title: Animal Puzzle
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Animal Puzzle combines animal-themed jigsaw assembly with dot-connecting activities. Choose a picture or puzzle and work through its parts to reveal the finished animal scene. Use the shapes and outlines as clues for what belongs together.

pages.title: Crazy Courier Ride
pages.creator: Dob5 Games
pages.description: Crazy Courier Ride sends a motorcycle courier through delivery missions. Complete the routes while collecting red gems to unlock better bikes. Work through the levels by keeping the rider moving toward each delivery objective.

pages.title: Jigsaw Puzzle: Cute Kittens
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Jigsaw Puzzle Cute Kittens offers four kitten pictures with an adjustable number of pieces. Reassemble your chosen image and try to improve the time taken. Saved progress lets you return to the puzzles and compare results with earlier attempts.

pages.title: Penalty Shootout Multi League
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Penalty Shootout Multi League lets you choose a football team from twelve leagues for a penalty contest. Take part in the shootout and try to lead the team toward the trophy. Make the decisive attempts count as the contest unfolds.

pages.title: Bottle Flip Challenge
pages.creator: Happylander Ltd
pages.description: Bottle Flip Challenge asks you to judge a bottle's spin so it lands on stacked objects. Time each flip and aim for a stable landing on the next surface. Earn lives and unlock additional bottles as you improve.

pages.title: Just Don't Fall
pages.creator: Gamesign Studio
pages.description: Just Don't Fall is an endless platform challenge about keeping a character moving without a fatal drop. Time jumps and react to the changing obstacles along the route. Keep an eye on safe landing space as the attempt continues.

pages.title: Crusader Defence: Level Pack 2
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Crusader Defence Level Pack 2 gives you a city to protect through another series of tower-defense battles. Assemble defensive units and place them to meet the enemy approach. Adjust the force as the attacks become harder to hold back.

pages.title: Ancient Ore
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Ancient Ore takes jewel matching into a treasure mine. Drag an entire row to shift its gems and bring matching pieces into useful groups. Work toward the level's objectives while considering how each slide changes the rest of the board.

pages.title: Princess Best Date Ever
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Princess Best Date Ever helps Belle prepare for an evening with her crush. Begin with makeup, then choose a dress and accessories that suit the date. Coordinate the colors and clothing to complete her finished look.

pages.title: Blue Warehouse Escape Episode 2
pages.creator: Snapbreak Games AB
pages.description: Blue Warehouse Escape Episode 2 puts you back inside a warehouse with another escape to solve. Search the rooms for objects and keys, then work out where to use them. Combine the clues from your exploration to open the way out.

pages.title: Annie Fashion Outfit
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Annie Fashion Outfit takes Annie shopping for a renewed wardrobe. Choose a dress and shoes, then find a handbag that suits the combination. Explore the available clothing to put together her finished look.

pages.title: Mermaid Princess Fashion Day
pages.creator: Daria Games
pages.description: Mermaid Princess Fashion Day invites you into a princess's dressing room to create a new outfit. Start with a hairstyle, choose a dress and coordinate accessories such as a necklace and purse. Compare the options until the full look works together.
